problem: Before the summer rush, the till at Mateo's bike shop held 34 dollars. He spent Saturday fixing flat tyres for customers, and when he counted again the till held 71 dollars. How much money did the tyre repairs bring in?

follow_ups.question: On Sunday he takes 15 dollars from the till to pay for a box of inner tubes. How much money is in the till now?

problem: The fire station keeps spare helmets on a wall rack, and this morning only 7 were hanging there. A delivery truck stopped by, Captain Okafor hung up the new helmets, and now the rack holds 25. How many helmets came on the truck?

follow_ups.question: Each new helmet needs a reflective sticker, and the stickers come 6 to a sheet. How many sheets does the captain need?
That night, 9 firefighters each take a helmet from the rack. How many helmets are still hanging on it?

problem: Workers at a building site had stacked 23 bags of cement by the fence. To finish the walls on time, a forklift brought over more bags in the afternoon. By evening the stack had grown to 81 bags. Find how many bags the forklift brought.

A farmer has twenty-nine pumpkin plants growing in her patch. She wants a bigger harvest for the autumn sale, so she will plant more seedlings this week. When she is done there will be sixty-four plants. How many seedlings is she going to plant?

follow_ups.question: Each new seedling needs one stake, and she already owns 20 stakes. How many more stakes must she buy?

problem: Ravi's family keeps their board games on a tall shelf, and last spring there were 26 of them. At a school fundraiser he bought a few more to play on rainy afternoons. Now the shelf holds 41 games. How many games did Ravi buy at the fundraiser?

follow_ups.question: Every game he bought cost 3 dollars. What did he spend on them?

problem: The sewing club had saved 64 dollars in its supply jar. Members took the money to the fabric store and bought thread, buttons and a roll of felt for their quilt. When they got back, 18 dollars were left in the jar. What did the shopping trip cost?

problem: Ingrid baked her best cherry pie for the county fair. Entering it in the contest cost 8 dollars, and after paying she still had 45 dollars in her purse. How much money did she bring to the fair?

follow_ups.question: Her pie won a prize of 20 dollars. How much money does she have now?

problem: Mei's flower shop had 19 roses and 12 tulips left after a busy weekend. A wedding order was coming, so she drove to the grower and brought back more roses. Now there are 64 roses in the cooler. How many roses did she bring back?
